commit 485b21fa9262d42e4f80801f8b5cc706d6446ea2
Author:     John Bieling <john@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Mon Feb 24 11:56:00 2025 +0100
Commit:     John Bieling <john@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Mon Feb 24 11:56:00 2025 +0100

    Bug 1948454 - Make sure the "tree-listbox" custom element is available before initializing the mail3pane. r=tobyp
    
    This fail and fix is very similar to Bug 1947134.
    
    Stack trace:
    
    ```
    TEST-UNEXPECTED-FAIL | comm/mail/test/browser/folder-display/browser_folderPaneVisibility.js | uncaught exception
    TypeError: can't access property "size", folderTree.selection is undefined at handleEvent@chrome://messenger/content/about3Pane.js:4453:11
    _ensureVisibleRowsAreDisplayed@chrome://messenger/content/tree-view.mjs:1059:12
    reset@chrome://messenger/content/tree-view.mjs:739:10
    updateThreadItemSize@chrome://messenger/content/about3Pane.js:5034:16
    async*init@chrome://messenger/content/about3Pane.js:4298:10
    async*@chrome://messenger/content/about3Pane.js:168:20
    async*@chrome://messenger/content/about3Pane.js:138:8
    ```
    
    The intermittent fail happens when `folderTree.selection` is
    undefined. However, selection is a getter for an internal Map,
    which should be available as soon as a new instance of the module is
    created.
    
    I cannot find a scenario where this could happen, except when the
    custom element is not yet defined. We do wait for many other custom
    elements, but not for `tree-listbox`.
    
    This patch therefore makes sure that the `tree-listbox` custom element
    is defined, before executing the init code.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D239317

diff --git a/mail/base/content/about3Pane.js b/mail/base/content/about3Pane.js
index 7282e4fc248..2f9d690406d 100644
--- a/mail/base/content/about3Pane.js
+++ b/mail/base/content/about3Pane.js
@@ -148,6 +148,7 @@ window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", async event => {
   await customElements.whenDefined("thread-row");
   await customElements.whenDefined("thread-card");
   await customElements.whenDefined("tree-view");
+  await customElements.whenDefined("tree-listbox");
 
   UIDensity.registerWindow(window);
   UIFontSize.registerWindow(window);
